prompt: What must a ten-year-old child do during the family session?
promptZh: 十歲兒童在家庭時段必須如何？

options.text: Book a private lane a week ahead
options.zh: 提前一週預約私人泳道

options.text: Swim with an accompanying adult in the water
options.zh: 由成人在水中陪同游泳
options.whyZh: 十歲未滿十二歲，適用成人水中陪同規定。

options.text: Swim in the teaching pool even without an adult
options.zh: 即使沒有成人陪同，仍可在教學池游泳
options.whyZh: 公告未列教學池例外；家庭時段未滿十二歲的兒童須由成人在水中陪同。

options.text: Buy a towel from the café
options.whyZh: 公告只說不供應毛巾，未規定在哪裡購買。

explanationZh: 十歲未滿十二歲，適用成人水中陪同規定。
evidence: children under twelve must be accompanied in the water by an adult

vocabulary.note: 與指定照護或同行者一起行動。
為保持設備狀態而進行的保養或作業。
